releases.displayName: Patch Update: The Farm Has Music Again

items.text: Patch is out. Nearly all of it came from forum posts and reviews after the language update.

Blank menu buttons in Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Talk, Shop, Give, Open Chest and Pet all came up empty, for Qwerty and every shopkeeper. The buttons were a few pixels too short for those scripts, so the game drew nothing at all. They're bigger now.
The Korean pet button. It wasn't using the Korean word for petting. It says 쓰다듬기 now. Sorry about that one.
No music on the farm, the crossroads or the outskirts. Those three only ever had tracks for the opening seasons, so they went quiet when spring ended. They'll play the spring music year-round now.

Inventory slots holding on to a machine's rules. After a swap with the sell box, meal box, refinery, pet house or splicer, a slot could keep refusing what that machine wouldn't take, with no message, until you changed area.

Tooltips quitting mid-session. They could stop for the rest of a session if the screen under whatever you were hovering refreshed. We've fixed one way that happens, but we never got it to happen on demand. If yours still go missing, tell us what you were doing right before.
Changing language in Options. The Help tab, your mail and your quest log stayed in the old language until you reloaded. They update right away now.
Still open: a report of a save disappearing. If that's happened to you, the Bug Reporting thread or our Discord, with what you were doing at the time, is the fastest way to get it looked at.

Every fix up there started as a review or a forum post. If you've been playing, leave us one. We read them, and this patch is what that looks like. Our Discord is the other place we're reading, and it's the quickest way to put something in front of us.
See you on the outpost.

Hello from the outpost.
The patch first, because it matters more.
They were not unlocking on Steam. At all. If you have been playing and wondering why nothing ever popped, it was not you.

notes.title: The Video settings were lying to you

items.text: Fullscreen, resolution, refresh rate and vsync were all being saved properly and shown back to you correctly in the menu. None of them were ever applied to the game. So if you set those once, shrugged and carried on in the wrong resolution, that is why. They work now.

notes.title: The menus locking up after you changed region

items.text: This one was strange enough to be worth explaining. Moving between regions could leave the pause menu and the inventory unresponsive for the rest of the session, while chests and delivery bins carried on working perfectly, which made it look like only some screens had broken. It was a failure loading the weather forecast, which stopped the game handing menu input back. Fixed.

notes.title: A quest title that could quietly stall your story

items.text: A duplicate quest title could stop story events progressing in a save, with no error and no sign anything was wrong. Silently is the worst way for something to break. Fixed.

notes.title: Things that piled up the longer you played

items.text: Several event handlers were outliving the objects that owned them, including the new-recipe popup and the tooltip controller, and accumulating over a session. Cleaned up.
This patch is English only, on purpose. We cut it from before the localization work so the fixes above could reach you sooner rather than waiting on it. Localization is coming right behind it.

If you drifted off early, this is the honest pitch: it is the same game, with a good deal fewer reasons to close it. Between the Big Bug Squash and this one, most of what used to make people quit has been dealt with.
Come and tell us how it goes, including the parts that are still wrong. We read it.
See you on the outpost.

releases.displayName: The Big Bug Squash: Stability, Saves & Quality-of-Life Update

items.text: Hey Colonists!

We've pushed a big stability and polish pass to One Lonely Outpost: safer saves, a long list of crash fixes, and dozens of quality-of-life improvements across quests, gameplay, and performance. Here's everything in this update:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356530/152cceb04e817776c7b53f61b1ecda61a5880730.png"]
Your save can no longer be corrupted or lost if the game crashes or closes mid-save. Saves are now written safely, and a backup is kept automatically.
Fixed a crash when interacting with an Omninac incubator.
Fixed a crash that fired repeatedly once all scheduled mail had been delivered.
Fixed crashes in daily weather generation when a season had no weather deck, or an empty one.
Fixed a crash when starting drone fishing in water with no available fish.
Fixed crashes when powered structures (cookers, fabricators, the omniforge, generators, animal houses) were set up with a missing part.
Fixed an animal spawning into an area that had not finished loading.
Fixed errors when interacting with pet houses.

Fixed a softlock where quitting during certain story conversations could permanently stall a quest after reloading, including the questline that unlocks the mine. Quests now remember that a conversation finished.
Fixed input freezing after a cutscene ended unexpectedly, which could leave you unable to reach the end-of-day screen.
Fixed menus becoming permanently inaccessible (a softlock that previously forced a manual quit).
Festival celebration rewards are no longer lost when your inventory is full. Overflow rewards are now delivered to your mailbox.
Reloading a save no longer duplicates placed objects such as pet houses and items.
Your money can no longer drop below zero.
Weather effects now play correctly. Thunder, lightning, rain/snow/dust, and solar storms were previously not appearing.
Your companion now settles when you approach it, so you can interact with it instead of chasing it, and it no longer steals the interaction from the tile you're trying to use.
Bug catching now shows clear feedback (a red cursor) when a bug is spooked and can't be caught.
Animals are less likely to escape fenced areas, with tighter wandering and no more slipping diagonally through fence corners.
The Omnitool's gust no longer destroys placed objects.
Gifting an NPC no longer consumes your only copy of a key or lore item.
Volume and other settings now reliably save between sessions.
Removed a leftover "Errr" placeholder shown for unbound keys on the controls screen.
Fixed lag and stutter that built up over long play sessions and previously cleared only after a save-and-reload.
Fixed player-facing spelling (Synthetic Meat/Milk, Piranhafish, Xenoarchaeology, and more).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356530/104f852c68dd4415425c6fdb62b9a49bb0448f34.png"]
Thank you for playing, and for the reports that made this pass possible. See you on the outpost.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465550/One_Lonely_Outpost/"]
Just in time for the Winter Sale, we’re rolling out a small patch. A big thank you to everyone in our amazing community who reported bugs on our Discord—your feedback keeps the colony thriving!
Thunderstorm SFX is now affected by sound settings
Thunderstorm damage to objects has been reduced.
Updated descriptions for Fossilized Egg and Skull
Omni-tool upgrades are now applied instantly.
You can no longer interact with wildflowers while a bug drone is selected.
Resolved object placement issues on map borders.
Fixed growth time display for seeds—green thumbs rejoice!
Fixed descriptions of most crops; they should no longer be the same as their seeds.
Collecting a crop from an incubator now properly awards an Omnistar.
Lamp variants from colony upgrades now display correctly.
Keybind settings now save as they should—your controls, your way!

But wait, there’s bigger news! 🎉 One Lonely Outpost is now SteamDeck Verified! That’s right, you can take your outpost on the go, cozy up with your crops, and keep exploring your colony wherever you like.
Thanks for being part of this journey—we can’t wait to share more updates with you in the New Year! Until then, enjoy the holidays and happy farming.

Many of you ran into an issue where Duyi would go on a little walk... and just never return. We are happy to report that we went on an expedition this weekend to find him and he's been brought home! Check out the quick little patch notes below:
Duyi now has a set and correct place to sleep.
Incubator model was rotated 90 degrees to ensure the crop inside wouldn't be obscured.
To our incredible community,

First, we want to thank you for your incredible support and patience. Your feedback through our Discord and Steam Discussion boards has been invaluable in shaping the game and guiding our development throughout Early Access. We know we’ve been quiet as a dev team, but we’ve been hard at work crafting something truly special for you.

notes.title: Today, we’re excited to celebrate the release of the Act II Update!

items.text: ⚠️ It is recommended that you start a new save with this update. ⚠️

This marks a monumental milestone in the game’s journey, bringing a wealth of new content, features, and improvements. From new characters and quests to new systems and mechanics, this update is packed with exciting additions.

But this update isn’t just about expanding the world — it’s about bringing your feedback to life and ensuring an experience that’s both exciting and rewarding. Whether it’s fixing lingering bugs, adding game-changing systems like marriage, teleportation, and gene-splicing, or introducing exciting new areas like Harlow Wilds and Crystal Forest, we’ve worked tirelessly to deliver Act II to One Lonely Outpost.

notes.title: Here’s everything you need to know about Act II in a nutshell

items.text: 5 New Characters, Landers, and Marriage! Meet and recruit 5 new characters, each with unique storylines and quests. Propose to one of the 9 eligible NPCs and celebrate with a wedding cutscene!
15+ New Quests to advance the story, unlock new features, expand your colony, and deepen relationships.
2 Stunning New Maps, New Resources & Teleportation: Explore the resource-rich Harlow Wilds and the beautiful Crystal Forest and unlock the ability to teleport across the map.

Seasonal Overhaul and Dynamic Weather Systems: You can now experience FULL SEASONS! We have introduced dynamic weather, fully seasonal crops, and visually updated the whole world for each season! It’s important to note that crops now ONLY grow in their proper seasons; planting out-of-season causes withering!

Gene Splicing and Updated Mechanics: You can now create 5 new and unique crops that are only available through gene-splicing! We can’t wait for you to discover the vast amount of combinations possible as you unlock these new crop seeds. Each one has its own rarity - who will discover the LEGENDARY grade crop first? We have also added new ways to upgrade your Omnitool!

New Festival and Minigame to bring life to your colony. Celebrate Colony Founding Day with new NPC interactions, decor, and even fireworks! Learn a new way to harvest and grow crops outside of their season with the new tending minigame.
Steam Enhancements: Though they may seem small - their value is not! Cloud saves, trading cards, and achievements are now live!
Polished UI, Quality-of-Life Improvements, and Bug Fixes to create a smoother experience overall.
But that’s just the start! To see everything we’ve been working on, check out the full patch notes below and dive into the update today!

Again, thank you for your patience and the active feedback you have been providing us in our Discord through bug reports and open discussions. Your feedback during Early Access has really driven the changes and improvements in the Act II Update alongside our vision and story for One Lonely Outpost.

Join us in our Discord and provide any feedback you may have as you dive into the new content! This is the best place to help keep us organized with Bug Reports and player feedback about the game. Now - let’s dive into the full and detailed patch notes!
5 New Characters
Kai, Sydney, Stellan, Johnny, and Norm
Norm introduces weekly restrictions on colony policies. However, if you’re clever, you might find that a well-timed cake can persuade him to loosen those rules!
2 New Maps
Crystal Forest and Harlow Wilds
Includes new mining resources, new flowers, new fish, and new wildlife.
2 New Minigames

Tending: Take control of your crop growth in a whole new way. Success in this minigame means your crops will take just five days to grow, regardless of the season, giving you more flexibility in planning your harvests.
Gene-Splicing: Using your gene-splicing machine, powered by a reactor, you can experiment with combinations of seeds, fish, and insects to create five unique crops, each with their own rarity!
Full Seasons

Each season comes with its own unique crops, weather patterns, and environmental changes. Crops now grow only in their proper seasons, requiring careful planning to avoid withering fields. However, the stunning seasonal visuals—from snow-covered buildings in winter to lush greenery in spring—make it all worthwhile.
Dynamic Weather Patterns
Experience heavy snow and torrential rain alongside the existing weather patterns.

Sandstorms can sweep through and clear pests from your crops while Solar Storms add an extra layer of strategy by damaging machinery, which can be repaired using a toolbox or the Maintenance Minigame.
Omnitool Upgrades
Laser
Lucky Laser: Increases the chance of rare rocks dropping by 5%.
Salvage Module: Allows 100% resource recovery when destroying placed objects.
Spray
Nutrient Gel: Reduces crop watering time by 30%.
Pressure Matrix: Extends the spray cone by 1 tile.
Manipulator
Flora-Locator: Extends manipulation cone length by 1 tile.
Nutrient Integration: Instantly waters irrigated fields.
Gust
Hypercompressor: Extends the gust cone length by 1 tile.
Artifact Bonus: Doubles the chance of finding items in sand mounds.
Marriage Mechanic
Propose with a wedding band to one of nine eligible NPCs: Aaron, Eve, Linny, Sydney, Sally, Fadhili, Dirk, Johnny, or Stellan.
Celebrate the union with a wedding cutscene!
New Festival: Colony Founding Day
15 New Quests: Finish out the story!
Teleportation: Unlock the ability to go from one side of the map to the other instantly!

notes.title: Quality of Life Improvements & Bug Fixes

items.text: Quests & Rewards
Players noted missing rewards for some previous quests and events. These now grant rewards, which will arrive via mail
Updated quest descriptions to make objectives clearer, and improved Fadhili’s barks for better interactions.
Players will now receive an email notification when Linny and Duyi open their stores.
Early Game Adjustments
Aaron now opens his lander earlier, so players can visit without time constraints.
The main story will now proceed even if the player hasn’t grown their first plant, preventing potential progression blocks.
Expanded Content & Balancing
Added 33 new recipes for dishes, including special NPC rewards tied to relationship levels.
Balancing adjustments: Farm plants now drop seeds less frequently, but harvest and dish prices have been increased to compensate.
Colony Upgrades
Fadhili’s house now features an upgrade board, allowing you to build new colony features like lamps, alternate lamps, bridges, and stone paths.
UI Overhaul

A complete rework of menus, including the Main Menu, Options, Save Profiles, Character Creation, Equipment, Calendar, Quest Window, Mail Window, and Omninac Window, ensuring a cleaner and more intuitive interface.
Controller Support: We had great feedback about improving controller support!
Fixed issues with the Maintenance Minigame, ensuring smooth operation even in sabotaged conditions.
Tutorials support scrolling via controller
Addressed various input issues, such as:
Seamless transitions between controller and keyboard on the Day Summary screen.
On the color customization screen, the game now clearly highlights selections
Correctly displaying and updating UI icons.
Ensuring the mail window doesn’t open automatically at the start of a new day.
Fixing functionality for "Deliver quest item" and "Order" commands.
Shopping cart improvements: You can now remove individual items without accidentally clearing the entire cart.
Cloud Saves: Enjoy the game on the go or across PCs!
Trading Cards & Achievements: Show off what you achieve to your friends!

items.text: Hi everyone!
With Steam Next Fest rapidly approaching and our release date a little over a week away, we are excited to announce something we know many of you have been hoping for.

notes.title: There will be a public demo on Steam for everyone to try!

items.text: If you aren’t a backer, now is the perfect time to take your first bite of One Lonely Outpost. The demo will be available throughout Next Fest which starts on June 19th at 10:00 AM PST and goes until the 26th at 10:00 AM PST. Play around, get to know your faithful companion named Qwerty, and let us know what you think!
We also wanted to share some of the smaller improvements made to the game over the last month. So without further delay, here are our newest changes!
Updated Storage Locker Customization

We noticed that the original color choices for the storage lockers just weren’t quite giving the look we wanted. After a little bit of creative input and experimentation, we switched it up and changed them to a wider range of colors that now all look unique.
Omni-Forge & Refinery Interface

For a good while now, both the Omni-Forge and Refinery have been missing a handy-dandy interface, but that is a thing of the past. Now you can see the items as they are being processed. Just drop your items in and go about your day!

Hi everyone!

We are back once again with a small announcement and some footage of updated features that have been added to the game! After winding down from a hectic March, we dove right into the game again to get a few things tidied up and two much-requested features added to the current beta version.

First things first… One Lonely Outpost will be participating in the Steam Next Fest which will be running from June 19th to the 26th! We are super excited to have this opportunity to share our game with you all. ♥
Content Creators: if you would like early access to our Next Fest Demo, please drop your information in this Twitter thread!

Everything is really starting to come together and this month we made sure to get the two most requested features by the backers added to the game. These features were definitely needed and we are thankful to our amazing backers supporting us and giving us solid feedback along the way.

notes.title: Being in a menu now pauses the game.

items.text: This was a huge need as we all know that sometimes players need to step away for a few minutes or take some time to read through the different menus as they learn the game. Previously, all of this would take in-game time to do and if you stepped away you would risk passing out. Now you can relax and simply take your time exploring the menus and be confident that if you need to grab a snack you won’t pass out!

notes.title: And what all our beta players have been asking for…. stack splitting!!

items.text: Not being able to split stacks after they were combined quickly became an issue as our backers built larger farms, forcing them to sell large quantities of crops even if they only needed a few to meet the requirement. Now players can split a stack in half and quickly gather split stacks back together!
Thank you all again for your continued support and patience. We wouldn’t have made it this far without all of you.

releases.displayName: March Update: PAX, beta testing and more!

items.text: Hi everyone!
We're back again this month to show off some more of our progress with some current in-game footage! March was a busy month for us that included events, beta testing, and adventures!

We showcased an exclusive One Lonely Outpost demo at PAX East this year. This demo allowed players who are not part of Kickstarter Beta to play through the tutorial of our game. It was awesome being able to see everyone enjoy all the hard work we’ve been up to.

We are officially one month into the Beta with our Kickstarter backers and we couldn’t be happier with the excitement within the community. The Beta community has been hard at work alongside us this month, sharing valuable feedback and providing us with bug reports.
Thank you again to all our beta testers who have been active in our super secret beta discord channel!

In this month’s update, we wanted to show you a little more about fishing in One Lonely Outpost. We have put a lot of work into our fishing minigame since its original concept by introducing a more futuristic method of fishing: drones! We gave you a sneak peek in a previous AMA and we are excited to show you what it currently looks like in the game today.
The Piranha Drone is our beginner-friendly fishing drone. Designed for shallow waters, it is a simple, efficient design. Check it out in action:

Like fishing, we are utilizing the use of drones for specimen collection. While you explore the planet keep an eye out for bugs to collect using your drone. Here’s a sneak peek of one of the bugs that you can collect - we’ll hopefully show you more soon! 😉
Last but not least, we introduced you to Jim-Bob’s daughter Elisha in our previous update.
While doing some exploring during our in-game testing we caught Elisha doing the same! You need to be quick to spot her, but it was fun seeing one of our NPCs out in the world.
This area is a crossroads, full of crystals and alien ruins… which is probably why we caught Elisha exploring there! Being the first to meet intelligent life is her goal, after all!
We can’t wait for you to explore the planet yourself!
Thank you all for your continued support and patience. We wouldn’t have made it this far without all of you.
Hopefully you’ve all kicked off the new year strong. We certainly have 😄We’ve got a lot to cover this month, so let’s just jump right into it!
Yes, you read that right. We are delaying again, but not by much! We are very excited to announce that we will for sure be launching One Lonely Outpost into Early Access in June of 2023!

We know you all have been waiting for a while but we’re nearly there. Five months will fly by and we’re excited about the progress we’ve been making over the past months that have led us to be able to make this final decision for June. We’re hopeful that the wait will be worth it and we’re definitely looking forward to hearing everyone’s feedback throughout Early Access.
Now who’s ready to see some of the progress we’ve made over the past month:

Eve is our xenoarcheologist that has joined the colony to learn about the beings that may have come before. You may be wondering, “but she’s blue? Isn’t she an alien?” Well she is of Itrii heritage, but she is in fact, just like you and I, a human, just a blue one. 😄
Much like Aaron and Jimbob, the rest of our cast is getting a little bit of a refresh to their character art. This is still very much work in progress for the new HD version.

We’re not only going to be updating the face a little bit, but also fixing her base pose. She has a tendency to hide her face and having a default pose will allow people to better see what is important.

Duyi has gotten the same art update treatment as our other NPCs. We had originally tried him out with the more realistic art style that we tried with Aaron, but upon hearing the communities feedback, we changed course and we went back to the old art like before and updated from there.

Duyi is our outpost metallurgist and will be there for all of your metal needs. As you can see from his outfit alone, he works in a pretty dangerous place and needs to wear protective equipment. For his pants and reinforced Tabi shoes, we took some inspiration from Japanese construction workers.

We’ve also been continuing on our journey of finishing up more NPC landers and updating the lighting a bit. This month, we have Sydney’s to show off! Her lander doesn’t have the fancy new lighting implemented just yet, but you can see how far her lander has come from before.
We’re looking forward to seeing what all yall have in store for us 😉

Hey everyone! We’re still hard at work to hopefully be bringing you more content soon and get back on track with showing off all our hard work. For this month's update, as promised with our last update, we have some new and improved art to show off to you all today.
